## Install R and R-Studio

Setup R and R-Studio. You should only have to do this once on your computer. Follow along with the video tutorial for additional support.

**Installing R:**

1. Go to the official R project website at https://www.r-project.org/.
2. Click on the "Download R" link on the left-hand side of the page.
3. Select your operating system (Windows, Mac, or Linux) and choose the latest version of R for your system.
4. Click on the download link for your operating system, and wait for the download to complete.
5. Once the download is complete, run the installer program and follow the instructions on screen to install R on your system.
6. After the installation is complete, launch R to verify that it is working properly.

**Installing RStudio:**

1. Go to the official RStudio website at https://rstudio.com/products/rstudio/download/.
2. Click on the "Download" button under "RStudio Desktop" to download the latest version of RStudio for your operating system.
3. Run the installer program and follow the instructions on screen to install RStudio on your system.
4. Once the installation is complete, launch RStudio to verify that it is working properly.

You now have R and RStudio installed on your system, and you're ready to run the FDL Toolbox through either R (command line) or the R-Shiny App.
